title: Leap Year Checker

content.problemStatement: Given a year, check whether it is a leap year

solution.approach: Check if a year is a leap year using standard Gregorian calendar rules.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: A year is leap if (y % 400 == 0) or (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0). Print 'Leap Year' or 'Not a Leap Year'.

hints: Divisible by 100 but not 400 is not leap.
Divisible by 4 but not 100 is leap.
